result.description: Help desk platform (QualityUnit) unifying email, live chat, calls and social tickets in one shared inbox, with AI agents.
result.auth_detail: REST API v3 uses a per-account API key sent in an `apikey` header; admins create keys with per-key permissions under Configuration > System > API. v1 uses a separate key. OAuth 2.1 and bearer token exist only for the built-in MCP server, not the REST API.
result.access_detail: No app review, listing or partner status is needed. Each customer admin creates their own API key on their own account, so that is not a gate. There is no permanent free plan: the only free option is a 30-day no-card trial, and the free-plan page is just the trial signup. After the trial, the API needs a paid plan (Starter and up). The pricing page lists an "API keys" row on every tier, but I could not extract per-tier API availability beyond that, so it is not confirmed that every tier includes API access. The built-in MCP server for external tools is Business and Enterprise only.
result.api_notes: REST API v3 covers tickets, customers, agents, departments, knowledge base, calls, chat and more. The reference is Swagger-style and is opened from the agent panel (admin only), and there are generated SDKs (Python and others). API v1 is legacy. I did not open the live reference to count endpoints.
result.blocker: No free tier: developers get a 30-day trial only, then need a paid plan. Per-account API key means no OAuth for end users. Docs sit behind an admin login.
